data.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

Add resolve_ticket_id() function to ticket-lib.sh. Makes T6 tests pass.

Resolution order (try each in sequence, return first match):
1. Exact 16-hex canonical match (passthrough)
2. Exact 8-hex canonical match (backward compat — return as-is, never reject)
3. Alias match: scan CREATE events for data.alias == input
4. jira_key match: lookup via jira-key index if present
5. Unique unambiguous prefix match (>= 4 chars): scan all ticket IDs for unique prefix
6. If 2+ matches found at step 5: exit non-zero, print 'Ambiguous: matches <id1> <id2> ...' to stderr

Function is read-only — must never modify ticket store.
Register in ticket-lib-api.sh dispatch table under subcommand 'resolve'.

depends_on: T5 (5809-7b5e), T6 (b5f0-1e18)
Story DD coverage: SC2
Retry budget: 2 attempts
data.title: GREEN: implement multi-form resolver resolve_ticket_id() in ticket-lib.sh
